payload.reasoning: Violates the property that the image is not written using a tiled format when it should be written using a strip format.
payload.precode: if (isTiled(tif)) { tif->tif_tilesize = TIFFTileSize(tif); if (!tif->tif_tilesize) { TIFFErrorExt(tif->tif_clientdata, module, "%s: cannot handle zero tile size", tif->tif_name); return (0); } } else { if (!TIFFStripSize(tif)) { TIFFErrorExt(tif->tif_clientdata, module, "%s: cannot handle zero strip size", tif->tif_name); return (0); } }
payload.aftercode: if (!isTiled(tif)) { tif->tif_tilesize = TIFFTileSize(tif); if (!tif->tif_tilesize) { TIFFErrorExt(tif->tif_clientdata, module, "%s: cannot handle zero tile size", tif->tif_name); return (0); } } else { if (!TIFFStripSize(tif)) { TIFFErrorExt(tif->tif_clientdata, module, "%s: cannot handle zero strip size", tif->tif_name); return (0); } }
